description: This file defines the abstract class UserDefinedType for creating custom user-defined data types (UDTs) in Spark SQL, along with a specific implementation for Python UDTs. It includes methods for serialization, deserialization, type acceptance, and JSON representation.

classes.name: UserDefinedType
classes.description: Abstract class for user-defined data types in Spark SQL, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, type acceptance, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: PythonUserDefinedType
classes.description: Concrete implementation of UserDefinedType for Python UDTs, handling serialization/deserialization and type acceptance for Python-specific UDTs.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a user type object to a SQL datum.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a SQL datum back to the user type.

methods.name: acceptsType
methods.description: Checks if a given DataType is accepted by this UDT.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the UDT.

methods.name: userClass
methods.description: Returns the Java class object for the user type.

methods.name: stringifyValue
methods.description: Converts a value of the UDT to a string.
